notes.title: Update v1.0.0.2
notes.content:
We prepared a small update for some minor bug fixes.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Fixed sound distance of monsters
    [*]Fixed bug where players glitched through the ground in the catacombs
    [*]Players can't glitch and look through the ceiling anymore
[/list]
